text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
And with that last event, the top overall 
point scorers have been decided!!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Sonon Elfie has been clocking phenomenal 
records throughout every stage so far! 
Once again, she advances to the finals 
with the top score of the venue!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
However,
<chrname> from Tracen Academy closed in 
fast on Sonon Elfie, turning this into a 
white-hot battle!!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
These two are without a doubt the top 
favorites to win! How will their clash in 
the finals turn out?!
Keep your eyes glued 
to the track!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
—That was a fiercely close match...!
Truly 
impressive!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
I'll train myself all over again before 
the finals! I promise I'll push past my 
limits, so please look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
And together, let's create the greatest 
final tournament ever!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sononet Elfie is sure to be our greatest 
rival in the finals as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bracing ourselves together with <chrname>,
we 
finally took our steps toward the final 
showdown!
